claim: Ours: hang a chained thing (lantern, skeleton) at the height that matters, its lamp or body, and let the chain run up into the ceiling rather than shrinking the chain to fit a low room: chains shrunk to repeat 32-40 read small and odd in Gravesend. sprite_fit then reports such a chain as 'through' the ceiling, which is expected. Whether Blood's own chains run into ceilings has not been counted.
evidence: bloodmap/light_stage.py:350-360: a 'hanging' lamp is lifted until its foot clears the floor with its head kept under the ceiling (built for the owner's ruling chains-sink-into-ceilings, 2026-11-21); projects/blood-city/references/sewer-design.md: Graves Brook's chain lamps (641) read 19% through the vault
use: A layout-placed sprite still needs its origin (the chain's top for 689/641) under its sector's ceiling; the light stage places on the finished map and is not held to that.
